method_source: Existing P10/reconstruction/PROTOCOL.md (paper III and thesis printed88-91): strict partial ASSUME; Combine conjoins conditions; Mux is non-strict in unselected branch. Independent reconstruction; no original Intel implementation.
changes: Propagate outer Assume through Mux value branches while preserving condition
Combine nested Assume by canonical flattened, sorted, duplicate-free And
Do not charge erased Assume care metadata as DAG circuit dependencies; shared across every arm
arms: legacy: old rule subset with corrected common extractor
combine: add Mux propagation and nested Combine
delay_targets: D and2D for ALL arms, D is original typed-AST proxy delay, determined before optimization. Same costs and budget. No synthesis selection feedback.
expected: Combine should expose joint outer/inner bounds and enable narrowing in nested arithmetic; no guaranteed gate benefit. Propagation-only isolates whether Combine supplies additional information. Retain ties, regressions, every failure and selected delay variant.
controls: Definedness+value: Combine, duplicate canonicalization, Mux propagation, Create, strict Add propagation UNSAT; OR instead of And, missing outer assumption, bottom as zero SAT. Whole-module negatives: dropped outer guard, wrong inner polarity, unconditional truncation SAT in both engines.
acceptance: Each positive output must prove full-domain unconditional Z3 BV and independently parsed RTL Yosys SAT. All counterexamples required. Abort remaining optimizer work on first failure; retain stdout/stderr, partial journal and attempt. No retry without recorded diagnosis and revised attempt directory. Run the first three arms as the initial slice of the one matrix; no duplicated pilot.
resources: APRIL dedicated existing envs/rover; taskset16-23 (8 distinct physical cores), single sequential experiment runner, BLAS/OpenMP8; check live load and MemAvailable before work.
limitations: Three authored in-sample combinational kernels, total Boolean care conditions only; no sequential/XZ/general SV frontend, signed division or arbitrary operators; bounded saturation; generic synth -noabc gates/depth and uncalibrated proxy area, no physical PPA or full-paper claim.
publication: Only this existing public branch, no PR or force; review credentials/internal information/license before normal fast-forward push. Do not publish environments/cache/credentials.
